title: Guest first/reload: pinned backend source-impact audit

comparison.conclusion: The explicitly checked guest start router and organization resolver are unchanged in the pinned backend diff. Other changed conversation-context/reader code and dependency snapshots leave indirect runtime effects unverified. This source audit does not extend workflow 37247813922's runtime pass to c79ac05f.

source_basis: The pinned diff name-status shows no changes to aidream/api/routers/ai.py or aidream/services/organizations/effective_org.py, the guest start router and organization resolver explicitly checked in this audit.

The backend delta does change aidream/services/conversation_context/source_attribution.py and aidream/services/distillation/chat_import.py. The former adds the agent-studio attribution token; the latter extracts the own-conversation reader. Their indirect or transitive effects on guest behavior were not runtime-verified.
The added /agent-studio/from-chat endpoint is mounted with require_authenticated. It is signed-in additive functionality, not the guest chat-start or reload route.
The admin Agent Studio route and reader's admin-only owner bypass are separate from guest request handling.

changed_paths_with_plausible_but_indirec.assessment: Shared own-chat text-reader extraction; no guest-path caller found in this delta. Could merit coverage of its signed-in consumers, not a guest transport regression signal.
Adds the agent-studio source feature token; attribution vocabulary only.

Runtime dependency snapshots move matrx-ai 0.5.467→0.5.468 and matrx-files 0.2.253→0.2.254 among other package bumps. No source evidence ties these updates to guest request assembly; source audit cannot rule out runtime effects.

acceptance_implications.prior_runtime_evidence: The exact Store candidate 205 native guest first/reload workflow 37247813922 passed against 2e24fa8536c149663735c0cf2092cd21f5a97144 only.
acceptance_implications.precise_follow_up: If current-backend acceptance is needed, rerun only the same exact Store-205 native guest first/reload scenario against c79ac05f44010430f509f27427a1663c4960a06f, recording before/after version endpoint observations. acceptance_implications.claim_boundary: The source delta shows no direct change to the checked guest start router or organization resolver, but does not establish transitive guest-path behavior or a runtime pass; no all-health conclusion follows.
